english: From a $4\times4$ board of unit squares, the unit square at one corner is removed. A rectangle in the remaining figure is a rectangle with sides along the grid lines that is made up only of unit squares of the remaining figure. Then the number of rectangles in the remaining figure that are not squares is ______.
hindi: इकाई वर्गों के एक $4\times4$ बोर्ड से एक कोने का इकाई वर्ग हटा दिया जाता है। शेष आकृति में एक आयत वह आयत है जिसकी भुजाएँ ग्रिड रेखाओं पर हैं तथा जो केवल शेष आकृति के इकाई वर्गों से बना है। तब शेष आकृति में उन आयतों की संख्या, जो वर्ग नहीं हैं, ______ है।
solution: Rectangles containing the corner square: row interval and column interval both start at the corner: $4\cdot4=16$
Of these, squares: one of each size $1,2,3,4$: $4$; non-squares $12$
solution_full: On the full $4\times4$ board a rectangle is fixed by 2 of the 5 horizontal and 2 of the 5 vertical grid lines: $\binom{5}{2}^{2}=100$ rectangles. Squares of side $k$ number $(5-k)^{2}$, so there are $16+9+4+1=30$ squares and $70$ non-square rectangles.

A rectangle lies in the remaining figure iff it does not contain the removed corner square. A rectangle contains that square iff its row interval starts at the first row and its column interval starts at the first column: $4\cdot4=16$ rectangles.
Among these 16, the squares are those with equal row and column lengths: sizes $1,2,3,4$, i.e. 4 squares; so 12 are non-squares.
Non-square rectangles in the remaining figure: $70-12=58$. (Similarly there are $100-16=84$ rectangles and $30-4=26$ squares in it.)
originality_note: New: rectangles that are not squares in a board with a corner removed, counted from the full-board formulas by removing the rectangles through the corner, which are exactly those with intervals starting at the corner (way 5). Closest known: 'number of squares / rectangles on an n x n board'. Different because: both the rectangle and the square counts must be corrected for the removed cell.

Number of squares and rectangles in a grid

concept_use.Number of squares and rectangles formed: The full-board counts C(5,2)^2 = 100 rectangles and 30 squares are the grid-structure formulas.
concept_use.Number of squares and rectangles in a gr: The rectangles through the removed corner square (16, of which 4 squares) are subtracted from the grid counts.
